notes: Corrective validation declared on 2026-09-14 after diagnosing misspecification of the legacy native mixed score on the restricted conditional-Gaussian benchmark.
The graph-recovery outcomes from the earlier V3 run were inspected before this correction; this cohort must therefore be reported as corrective validation, not untouched confirmation.
The score is selected from the declared statistical model class, never from the benchmark or dataset name.
Restricted CLG-BIC has no fitted score hyperparameters: it uses local maximum likelihood and the ordinary 0.5*k*log(n) BIC penalty.
Candidate screening, structure prior, SMC schedule, MCMC controls, and compute allocations are unchanged from execution_v3_confirmatory_v1.json.

The held-out full-cohort master seed is 20260917; operational smoke uses 20260916. The d=8 panel is exactly enumerated and tests sampling against the corrected target as well as graph recovery and seed stability.
